**Company Description** 
 A.M.JEEWAJEE \& SONS, established in 1985, is a leading distributor and manufacturer in West Bengal, India, serving industrial clients across India and abroad. The company specializes in conveyor, elevator, and roller chains and accessories in both American and German standards, covering a wide range of pitches from 4 mm to 3 inches. Its product portfolio includes heavy series bush chains, double pitch roller chains, RO type heavy\-duty chains, stainless steel chains, leaf chains, gate chains, and slat conveyor chains with linear and curved movements. The role also involves providing pre\- and post\-sales customer support, maintaining accurate sales records and reports, and contributing feedback to improve sales strategies and product positioning. The Sales Specialist will collaborate with management to meet sales targets and may support training sessions for clients or colleagues on product features and applications.

* Ability to deliver results within tight timelines.
* Attention to details, analyzing abilities.

* Knowledge of financial markets and products to assist in meaningful engagement with clients.

* Enhance knowledge base, build skill sets \& develop competencies
* Execute at speed while maintaining error free operations

title: Head of Fundraising
description:
**Head of Fundraising \& Investor Relations, East – Kolkata** 




 Vantrock Investment Managers LLP
 



  





**Vantrock is a multi\-product real assets platform. Not a warehousing fund.** 
 Logistics and industrial is the first strategy. Office, plotted sales, land, pre\-leased and yielding assets, private credit, data centres and senior living follow behind it. This seat builds the distribution network for all of it in Kolkata and the East.
 



**THE SEAT** 




**Employer:** 
 Vantrock Investment Managers LLP, the investment manager within Vantrock Ventures
 



**Reports to:** 
 Chief Business Officer, Fundraising and Investor Relations. Until that seat is filled, directly to the Founder \& CEO, who will build the franchise with the zonal team hands\-on
 



**Direct reports:** 
 None at launch. A senior single\-contributor seat with a very large number attached
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata, in office, with twelve to fifteen travel days a month across Kolkata, Guwahati, Bhubaneswar, Patna, Ranchi and Raipur
 



**Experience:** 
 10 to 16 years
 



 Team structure, reporting lines, seat titles and hiring entity reflect the current plan and may change. Compensation is confirmed in the offer.
 



**ABOUT THE COMPANY** 




 Vantrock is an operator\-led real assets platform, and it is multi\-product by design. Real assets only. Warehousing and industrial parks are
 **the first strategy, not the platform** 
 , across the full chain: first mile, last mile, city\-centre, dark\-store and self\-storage formats, and logistics\-anchored mixed\-use with distribution below and office above.
 



 Behind that first strategy sits the rest of the platform, launched in sequence and only as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back\-office space, where our expertise transfers directly; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living. Each is a strategy in its own right, with its own pipeline and its own distributor relationships behind it.
 **A candidate who reads this as a warehousing platform has read the first line and stopped.** 




 Three parts, kept separate. The founder's balance sheet takes the first risk: land is acquired, de\-risked and approved on his capital before any investor commits. Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited develops and operates; Vantrock Investment Managers LLP underwrites every asset independently and answers to an independent Investment Committee. Assets enter at cost, with no founder premium. The platform earns only after its investors have.
 



 Founded by
 **Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO** 
 . Three institutional platforms built from zero, and the fourth now on his own capital. Across that career: India's largest industrial real estate exit, Rs 5,250 Cr to Blackstone; a fund platform taken from zero to about USD 1\.4 billion in peak AUM in six years, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, Rs 2,775 Cr from roughly 1,000 investors through the channel, on India's first domestic warehousing AIF; 52 million sq ft delivered, 32 million as developer and 20 million as contractor; 2,000\+ acres acquired, all litigation\-free; 200\+ buildings. Delivered across the founder's three prior platforms.
 



**Warehousing is where the founder is best known. It is not where this platform stops.** 
 That record is the anchor that opens the door in the channel. The mandate you would be selling is considerably wider than it.
 



 We hire number twos who want to become number one.
 



**THE PRODUCT SET YOU WOULD BE SELLING** 




 This is the part most candidates get wrong. You would not be carrying one product into the channel. You would be building a channel that carries a succession of products across real assets. The proposed set, built out in sequence as each is delivered and as approvals are obtained:
 



 – Industrial parks, logistics and warehousing
 



 – Office: suburban campuses, GCC and back\-office space, starter and strata office
 



 – Plotted and industrial plot sales
 



 – Pre\-leased and yielding assets
 



 – A land strategy
 



 – Private credit
 



 – Data centres and senior living
 



 – In time, listed or pooled vehicle formats including InvIT and REIT structures
 



**Multiple product lines, one channel.** 
 That is why this is a franchise\-building job rather than a product\-selling job. An RM you certify on the first strategy sells the second, third and fourth without being recruited again.
 



 The intended route is a seeded AIF alongside deal\-by\-deal co\-investment through CIV, co\-investment PMS and other structures, subject to approvals. Seeded is the point: the operator puts assets in place before a fund launches, so much of the pipeline is de\-risked on day one and no blind pool is raised. Two sales in one: a fund commitment into a visible pipeline, and larger co\-investment tickets into named assets.
 



**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS** 




**Own the zone.** 
 Build the distribution and IFA network across East and North\-East India: Kolkata, Guwahati, Bhubaneswar, Patna, Ranchi and Raipur. Activate the RMs and advisers inside it, and convert that network into committed capital for the first strategy and into a channel that is ready when the office, plotted, land, credit and yielding strategies arrive behind it.
 



**Not a cold start.** 
 The platform brings an existing investor base, anchor commitments in place, and a founder known in the channel from two prior funds. The channel will take the meeting. What does not yet exist is the franchise: the empanelments, the certified RMs, the joint calls. There is no team to delegate that to in Year 1\. Seniority here means credibility and judgment, not a desk.
 



**WHAT YOU WILL OWN** 




 – The network. National distributors' regional offices, regional distributors, IFAs and MFDs, DSAs, RIAs, multi\-family offices and wealth\-platform desks. Target 5 to 7 firms empanelled and live.
 



 – The full empanelment cycle, locally. First meeting to product committee to go\-live, for both the fund and the co\-investment routes. Empanel the platform, not a single product, so the next strategy does not start the cycle again.
 



 – Activation. Branch meetings, huddles and desk conversations until 35 to 50 RMs and IFAs have each placed at least one ticket.
 



 – Conversion. Joint client meetings as the core of the job. The pipeline from interest through contribution agreement to funds received.
 



 – The map, in the CRM, weekly. Investor relations in the zone after the close, with Fund Operations. The face of Vantrock in the East.
 



**THIS IS A FRONT\-FACING SEAT** 




 You do not sell to the distributors and stop. You sell with them. Accompany partners and their RMs to their clients and pitch yourself. Tell the story so an RM can repeat it under pressure. Host investor evenings, partner meets and site visits, speak where the channel meets the asset class, and be a named voice of the platform on LinkedIn.
 



**Approved material only. Nothing bespoke, nothing verbal\-only, no return promises, ever.** 




**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




**Essential** 




 – 10 to 16 years in financial services, at least five in B2B or B2B2C distribution of PMS, AIF or mutual\-fund products from the manufacturer's side, an AMC, alternatives manager or fund house. You have carried a distribution number and been paid against it.
 



 – Verifiable relationships with distributor product heads, national and regional distributors and the top IFA and MFD firms in East and North\-East India. You can name them, and they will take your call.
 



 – You have launched a product into the channel from scratch at least once, not only carried an established brand.
 



 – Third\-party capital raised through the channel, stated as capital drawn, not assets influenced.
 



 – Graduate. MBA, PGDM, CA or CFA or equivalent. NISM as applicable.
 



 – Appetite for the road. Twelve to fifteen travel days a month is the job, not an exception to it.
 



**Advantageous** 




 – A real assets fund background. Not mandatory: a strong alternatives channel salesperson from equity, credit or PMS is often the superior hire, because channel sales is harder to teach than an asset class.
 



 – Experience carrying more than one product line into the same channel. This platform will ask you to do it repeatedly.
 



 – An AMC alternates or PMS desk. Co\-investment tickets sold alongside a fund. Standing in the Marwari, Bengali and North\-East business communities, where alternatives penetration is low relative to wealth and a well\-run fund house faces less competition.
 



**COMPENSATION AND WEALTH CREATION** 




 Benchmarked against the upper quartile, then deliberately weighted from take\-home to wealth creation. Four parts, offered as a mix: fixed; a fundraising incentive on the capital you personally bring in, with a team component on the platform's total raise; a share in the platform's additional returns on strategies you help close; and ESOPs. Numbers in the first conversation.
 



**Prepared for recruitment only. Not an offer of, or invitation to invest in, any fund, scheme, security or interest, and not marketing of any investment product. The product lines, structures and routes described are proposed and indicative, subject to change and to all necessary SEBI and other regulatory approvals. The track record above relates to the founder's prior roles at other organisations, is not the track record of Vantrock, and is not indicative of future results. No return is stated or implied, and none may be quoted in connection with this search.** 




 Approve and West follows.

description:
WE ARE HIRING \| SENIOR LEATHER SALES \& MERCHANDISER – EXPORT
 



  





 Company: Exalter Global Co.
 



 Location: Kolkata, India
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



 Experience: 5\+ Years
 



 Department: International Sales \& Export Merchandising
 



  





 ABOUT THE ROLE
 



  





 Exalter Global Co. is looking for an experienced and highly proactive Senior Leather Sales \& Merchandiser to drive international B2B business development.
 



  





 The PRIMARY PURPOSE of this role is:
 



  





 FIND NEW INTERNATIONAL BUYERS → GENERATE ENQUIRIES → DEVELOP SAMPLES → CLOSE EXPORT ORDERS → BUILD LONG\-TERM ACCOUNTS
 



  





 This is NOT a passive account\-management or follow\-up role.
 



  





 We are looking for a sales\-driven BUSINESS HUNTER who can independently identify potential buyers, reach decision\-makers, initiate conversations, generate qualified enquiries and convert prospects into profitable international customers.
 



  





 ABOUT EXALTER GLOBAL CO.
 



  





 Exalter Global Co. is an established Indian manufacturer, exporter and supplier of premium leather goods, serving international B2B customers through OEM manufacturing, private\-label production and customized leather goods development.
 



  





 Our product capabilities include:
 



  





 • Leather Wallets
 



 • Leather Bags
 



 • Belts
 



 • Card Holders
 



 • Passport Holders
 



 • Laptop Bags
 



 • Other Leather Accessories
 



  





 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 1\. NEW INTERNATIONAL BUYER ACQUISITION – PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY
 



  





 • Identify new international buyers for our leather goods manufacturing and private\-label capabilities.
 



 • Research and build qualified buyer databases.
 



 • Identify founders, brand owners, sourcing managers, purchasing managers, procurement teams and category managers.
 



 • Prospect fashion brands, leather goods brands, lifestyle brands, retailers, wholesalers, importers, distributors, sourcing companies, e\-commerce brands and private\-label businesses.
 



 • Develop new B2B opportunities across the USA, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia, Middle East and other relevant markets.
 



 • Conduct proactive outbound prospecting through cold email, LinkedIn, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, B2B platforms, trade databases, directories, referrals, exhibitions and other legitimate B2B channels.
 



 • Initiate conversations with companies that have no previous relationship with Exalter Global Co.
 



 • Qualify prospects based on product requirements, sourcing needs, volumes, pricing and business potential.
 



 • Convert prospects into genuine business enquiries and RFQs.
 



  





 2\. INTERNATIONAL B2B SALES
 



  





 • Manage the complete sales cycle from prospect identification to purchase order.
 



 • Understand buyer requirements, target pricing, MOQ, product specifications and delivery expectations.
 



 • Prepare professional quotations and commercial proposals.
 



 • Conduct buyer discussions and sales presentations.
 



 • Negotiate pricing, MOQ, payment terms, lead times and commercial conditions.
 



 • Handle objections and move qualified opportunities toward sampling and order confirmation.
 



 • Follow up consistently and professionally.
 



 • Maintain a structured international sales pipeline.
 



 • Convert new accounts into repeat customers.
 



  





 3\. LEATHER GOODS MERCHANDISING
 



  





 • Understand leather goods construction, materials and manufacturing processes.
 



 • Handle wallets, bags, belts, card holders, passport holders and related accessories.
 



 • Understand leather types, finishes, thicknesses, colours, textures, hardware and construction.
 



 • Interpret buyer sketches, tech packs, reference images and samples.
 



 • Translate buyer requirements into clear product specifications.
 



 • Coordinate with sampling, sourcing, production and quality teams.
 



 • Recommend commercially viable product and manufacturing solutions.
 



  





 4\. PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT \& SAMPLING
 



  





 • Coordinate prototype and sample development for new buyers.
 



 • Communicate buyer specifications accurately to internal teams.
 



 • Track sample development, revisions and approvals.
 



 • Manage customized branding requirements such as embossing, debossing, foil stamping, printing, engraving, labels and packaging.
 



 • Ensure approved samples are correctly documented for production.
 



  





 5\. COSTING \& QUOTATIONS
 



  





 • Prepare accurate product costing.
 



 • Evaluate leather, hardware, accessories, labour, packaging and manufacturing costs.
 



 • Prepare competitive export quotations while protecting company margins.
 



 • Negotiate commercially viable pricing.
 



 • Understand FOB and relevant international trade terms.
 



 • Maintain accurate costing and quotation records.
 



  





 6\. ORDER CONVERSION \& PRODUCTION COORDINATION
 



  





 • Coordinate confirmed orders with production, sourcing, sampling and quality teams.
 



 • Monitor production schedules and critical milestones.
 



 • Ensure production follows approved samples and specifications.
 



 • Track quantities, quality and delivery timelines.
 



 • Identify potential delays and communicate proactively.
 



 • Support export and logistics teams through shipment execution.
 



  





 7\. BUYER RELATIONSHIP DEVELOPMENT
 



  





 • Develop newly acquired customers into long\-term accounts.
 



 • Identify repeat\-order and cross\-selling opportunities.
 



 • Introduce relevant new products and product categories.
 



 • Expand customer relationships and account value.
 



 • Maintain professional communication with international buyers.
 



  





 8\. MARKET RESEARCH \& BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT
 



  





 • Identify emerging international leather goods brands and businesses.
 



 • Research new markets and customer segments.
 



 • Monitor leather goods trends, competitor activity and international pricing.
 



 • Identify new OEM and private\-label opportunities.
 



 • Build actionable prospect lists and sales pipelines.
 



  





 9\. CRM \& SALES REPORTING
 



  





 Maintain accurate records of:
 



  





 • Prospects
 



 • Decision\-makers
 



 • Buyer communication
 



 • Enquiries
 



 • RFQs
 



 • Quotations
 



 • Samples
 



 • Follow\-ups
 



 • Negotiations
 



 • Purchase orders
 



 • Expected order value
 



 • Next actions
 



  





 KEY SALES KPIs
 



  





 Because NEW BUYER ACQUISITION is the primary purpose of this role, performance will be strongly measured by:
 



  





 • Qualified international prospects identified
 



 • New decision\-makers contacted
 



 • Buyer conversations generated
 



 • Qualified sales opportunities created
 



 • New RFQs/enquiries generated
 



 • Quotations submitted
 



 • Sample requests generated
 



 • Samples converted into purchase orders
 



 • New international accounts acquired
 



 • Value of new export orders secured
 



 • Gross margin generated
 



 • Repeat orders generated from newly acquired buyers
 



  





 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE
 



  





 • 5\+ years of experience in international B2B sales, export sales, leather goods merchandising, business development or a related manufacturing/export industry.
 



 • Proven experience in NEW CUSTOMER ACQUISITION.
 



 • Experience dealing with international buyers, brands, retailers, importers, wholesalers or sourcing companies.
 



 • Strong understanding of leather goods and manufacturing.
 



 • Experience with OEM, ODM or private\-label manufacturing is highly preferred.
 



 • Experience with product development, sampling, costing and quotations.
 



 • Strong international sales and negotiation skills.
 



 • Knowledge of export business and international trade practices.
 



 • Excellent spoken and written English.
 



 • Strong business\-email writing skills.
 



 • Good knowledge of Excel, email, CRM and sales\-development tools.
 



  





 PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
 



  





 Candidates with the following will receive strong preference:

 • Experience selling leather wallets, bags, belts or accessories.
 



 • Experience working with private\-label brands.

 • Experience using LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
 



 • Experience with cold email and outbound B2B sales.

 IDEAL CANDIDATE

 Products and services included in this area are electric generators for hydraulic and thermal power plants (biomass), hydro turbines (small hydroelectric plants or PCH, and hydroelectric generators or CGH)), wind turbines, transformers, substations, control panels and system integration services.
   

  

**Commercial and Appliance Motors**
 In this business area, our focus is the market of single phase motors for durable consumer goods, such as washing machines, air conditioners, water pumps, among others.
   

  

**Paints and Varnishes**
 In this area, which includes liquid paints, powder paints, and electro\-insulating varnishes, we have a very clear focus on industrial applications in Brazil and are expanding to Latin America and other regions.
